name: Royals Events Management
intro: From the first consultation to the last dance, we design, plan and manage weddings that feel effortless for you and unforgettable for your guests.

services.title: Full Wedding Planning
services.text: Venue sourcing, vendor selection, budgets, design and every detail in between. We carry the load from engagement to send-off.

services.title: Day-of Coordination
services.text: You've planned it — we run it. We confirm every vendor, build the run-of-show and manage the day so you can be present.

services.title: Venue & Vendor Sourcing
services.text: Trusted caterers, photographers, DJs, decorators and venues matched to your style and budget.

services.title: Multi-day & Cultural Ceremonies
services.text: Mehndi, sangeet, haldi, ceremony and reception — seamless coordination across every event and every family.

services.title: Guest Experience
services.text: RSVP tracking, seating charts, welcome bags, transport and hotel blocks so every guest feels looked after.

process.text: Tell us about your vision, date, guest count and budget.
We build a plan, mood board and vendor shortlist.
Track everything together in your private client portal.
We run the day. You enjoy every minute.

testimonials.quote: Thanks so so so much Shobi, Sanjay and Gobi. Couldn’t thank you guys more. Kept the day running smooth from start to finish and managed the timing accordingly. Reduced our stress a lot on the day! Appreciate it.
The client portal kept everything in one place — no lost emails, no stress.
